name: cyango
description: Edit a live Cyango xr/studio story: scenes, layout, models, and interactions.

interface.longDescription:
Cyango edits the story that is open in Cyango xr/studio. Ask for a change in plain words and see it land in the editor: add and arrange scenes, build GUI panels, buttons and text, place 3D models, primitives, lights and Gaussian splats, wire up actions and timelines, and insert free stock images and models with their author and license.

It also manages the product catalog of your Cyango shops: create, edit, move and delete products, and place them in a story.

Sign in with your Cyango account when you connect. Then open a story in Cyango xr/studio and turn MCP on in Story Settings, or select the link icon in the xr/stores header for catalog work. Saving a story stays a manual step in the editor.

Guide: https://cyango.com/docs/studio/ai-agents-mcp
defaultPrompt: Turn the first scene into a hotel-lobby welcome: a large title, one line of copy, and a Start button.
Stage a showroom in the first scene: a pedestal, a red sphere, and a warm spotlight aimed at it.
Find a free coastline photo, place it in the first scene, and credit the photographer and license.

positive.description: List the scenes. Setup: on a computer, sign in at https://studio.cyango.com with the test account from Review details, open the story Review sample, turn MCP on in Story Settings, and keep that tab open. ChatGPT Web and Mobile then both use that tab.
positive.prompt: What scenes are in my open Cyango story? Give the name and type of each scene.
positive.expected_behavior: The reply lists each scene of the sample story with its name and type, for example Lobby (TOUR_3D). Nothing in the story changes.

positive.description: Add a scene. Setup: on a computer, sign in at https://studio.cyango.com with the test account from Review details, open the story Review sample, turn MCP on in Story Settings, and keep that tab open. ChatGPT Web and Mobile then both use that tab.
positive.prompt: Add a new 3D tour scene called Gallery to my Cyango story.
positive.expected_behavior: One new TOUR_3D scene called Gallery is added. The reply confirms the name and gives the new scene ID. add_scenes with one row is also correct. If an earlier run added a Gallery scene, a second scene called Gallery is correct.

positive.description: Add text to a scene. Setup: on a computer, sign in at https://studio.cyango.com with the test account from Review details, open the story Review sample, turn MCP on in Story Settings, and keep that tab open. ChatGPT Web and Mobile then both use that tab.
positive.prompt: In the first scene of my Cyango story, add a text on the screen that says Welcome to the gallery.
positive.expected_behavior: One GUI_TEXT entity with the text Welcome to the gallery is added under the GUI_SCREEN of the first scene. The reply confirms the text and gives the new entity ID. Nothing else in the scene changes.

positive.description: Add a 3D object and change it. Setup: on a computer, sign in at https://studio.cyango.com with the test account from Review details, open the story Review sample, turn MCP on in Story Settings, and keep that tab open. ChatGPT Web and Mobile then both use that tab.
positive.prompt: In the first scene of my Cyango story, add a red sphere. Then make it twice as big and tell me its scale before and after.
positive.expected_behavior: One red sphere is added to the first scene. Its scale is then doubled on all three axes. The reply gives the sphere ID and the scale before and after the change, for example 1, 1, 1 and then 2, 2, 2. The sphere stays red.

positive.description: Rename a scene. Setup: on a computer, sign in at https://studio.cyango.com with the test account from Review details, open the story Review sample, turn MCP on in Story Settings, and keep that tab open. ChatGPT Web and Mobile then both use that tab.
positive.prompt: Rename the first scene of my Cyango story to Entrance.
positive.expected_behavior: The first scene is renamed to Entrance, and the reply confirms the new name. update_scenes with one row is also correct. If the first scene is already called Entrance, the reply says so and nothing changes. No other scene changes.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Lisbon today?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any Cyango tool: weather is outside this plugin. Answer through an appropriate weather capability if available, or explain that live weather is unavailable. Do not modify the story.

negative.prompt: Buy me a Cyango Pro subscription.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Cyango tools or purchase anything. Explain that the plugin cannot buy subscriptions or process payments; direct the user to the Cyango website to manage a plan. Do not claim a purchase occurred.

negative.prompt: Publish my Cyango story to the public web.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Cyango tools to publish and do not claim the story is public. Explain that publishing is outside the plugin tools and must be completed manually in xr/studio.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It can read the product catalog of a shop the user already has in Cyango, edit the products of Cyango shops (names, descriptions, variants, prices, stock, media, visibility), and link products to entities in the story. Shopify products keep their names, prices and stock from Shopify. Checkout happens only in the published Cyango story, outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Adds product catalog tools for xr/stores: create_products, update_products, delete_products and move_products. They edit products of Cyango shops; Shopify products only take media, AR and visibility changes. Products that a story uses are never deleted or moved. MCP can now connect from the xr/stores header, and bridge_status shows the connected app. The tools do not create shops, read orders or take payments.
